description: Fetches Central Government holiday lists from msasoi.in (DoPT O.M. documents), including Gazetted and Restricted holidays with Saka Era dates.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_holidays_2025: Fetch all 2025 Central Government holidays with full details; 参数: 无; 必填: 无
  - search_holidays: Search/filter holidays by name, Saka Era, or holiday type; 参数: query, saka_era, holiday_type; 必填: 无

query.description:
Search string to match in holiday names (case-insensitive).
Used by search_holidays function.

saka_era.description:
Filter by Saka Era (e.g., "1946 SAKA ERA", "1947 SAKA ERA").
Used by search_holidays function.

holiday_type.description:
Filter by holiday type: "Gazetted" or "Restricted".
Used by search_holidays function.
